disposition_reason: Narrative review of lead and cadmium sources, health effects and regulation for protein powders; it reports no new measurements and quotes third-party testing (e.g. a 2018 Clean Label Project survey: 70% of 134 powders with lead, 74% with cadmium).

study.design: Narrative review article (labelled 'Review Article'); no samples analysed

unresolved: No primary measurements; quoted figures come from other sources and are not findings.
The DOI printed on every page (10.62057/ESJ.2025.V2.I5) is issue-level wording; whether it resolves to this article specifically was not checked (no network).
The brief flagged an image-only first page; in this PDF the text layer of page 1 carries the title and authors.

regulatory_or_exposure.what: FDA interim reference level for lead (as quoted)
EFSA (2009) tolerable weekly intake for cadmium (as quoted)
